# Apex Quant Trading Workstation

> Apex Quant is an institutional-grade quantitative trading research workstation and live paper trading simulator for equities, F&O derivatives, and MCX commodities.

## Core Capabilities
- **Institutional Paper Trading**: ₹10,00,000 virtual balance with realistic Level-2 matching, multi-leg ticketing, and live MTM.
- **Systematic Algorithmic Engineering**: Bar-by-bar vectorized backtesting on live 15m tick bars (Pine Script v5 FVG inversion).
- **Multi-Asset Depth**: Trade NSE equities, NIFTY 50 / BANK NIFTY index options with real-time Greeks, and MCX commodities.
- **Statutory Charges & Ledger**: Authentic computation of STT, CTT, exchange turnover fees, GST, and SEBI charges on every virtual fill.
- **Analytics & Journaling**: Consolidated P&L, Sharpe ratio, win rate, drawdown tracking, and interactive trade tagging.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (FundingPips Institutional Theme).
- **State Management**: Zustand store (`useTradingStore`) with local in-memory fallback and Supabase cloud persistence.
- **Market Data Feed**: Upstox v2 REST API with streaming quote fallbacks.
- **Risk Management**: Dynamic margin calculation, MIS intraday leverage, and hard circuit breaker rules.
